== Description ==

Players listening during the evening prize ceremony of the [[2024 World Championship]] at Zu den Vier Winden, Bochum, on Day 1. [[Tamás Papp]], the tournament director, applauds at the back left in his bright blue T-shirt, and [[Casey Anis]] is seated at the front left in his pale yellow T-shirt. The other faces are not yet identified.
